title: Compiled measured duplicate-code data for the CTO's extended call
summary: Five weeks into the duplication program I compiled the results of every workshop and session, with before-and-after reports, for the CTO's extended call, so leadership could discuss code quality from measured data.
what_would_have_happened: Code quality would have been discussed as opinion at the top table.
the_call: Give leadership measured results from the teams' own code.
what_i_did: Compiled workshop and session results since 9 September, with before-and-after reports, into a tracking sheet for the call.
what_changed: A senior director asked for a mechanism to remove and commit 23% of the duplicate code.
